title: Review: Classification and phylogeny; Biodiversity and its measurement; Speciation
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for CCEA A-level Biology (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: EV06c#t3 term and clue written for the game; EV07a#t4 term and clue written for the game; EV07a#t2 term and clue written for the game; EV07b#t2 term and clue written for the game. Questions: EV05a#N.2, EV06a#N.7, EV06b#N.3, EV06c#N.7, EV07a#N.6c, EV05a#N.10a, EV06a#N.9, EV07a#N.9b, EV05a#N.11, EV06a#N.12. Some questions repeat from the worlds it reviews.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Eukarya
items.clue: Top-level group containing Protoctista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia

items.label: Ecosystem diversity
items.clue: The range of habitats present, e.g. sand dune, woodland, meadow, stream

items.label: Species evenness
items.clue: How equally the individuals are spread among the kinds of organism present

items.label: Alleles
items.clue: What members of one species differ in, although they all have the same genes

questions.stem: According to the biological species concept, what is a species?

options.text: A group of organisms that can mate and produce offspring of any kind
A group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring
A group of organisms that resemble one another in every visible trait
A group of organisms that live in the same area and interbreed with one another

questions.explanation: Fertility of the offspring is the decisive condition in the biological species concept.

questions.stem: Which statement about the scientific name of the tiger, Panthera tigris, is correct?

options.text: The second word, tigris, is on its own enough to identify the species of tiger.
It should be written Panthera Tigris, because both of its words are proper nouns.
Panthera names the genus and tigris distinguishes the species within it.
Panthera tigris and Panthera leo are varieties of one species and interbreed freely.

questions.explanation: First word, genus; second word, the species within that genus. Panthera leo, the lion, shares the genus and has similar traits.

questions.stem: Using the cytochrome c data, which conclusion is best supported?

options.text: Humans evolved from chimpanzees, because their cytochrome c sequences are identical.
Humans share a more recent common ancestor with the dog than with the tuna.
The tuna is the least evolved of these animals, because its protein differs most from ours.
The dog and the chicken differ from each other at 2 positions, since 13 − 11 = 2.

questions.explanation: 11 differences against 21. Differences accumulate after lineages split, so fewer differences mean a more recent common ancestor.

questions.stem: Which evidence was used in 1977 to propose that all organisms should be classified into three domains?

options.text: Visible differences in cell structure seen using the electron microscope.
Evidence that archaea are a subgroup of bacteria, so that all prokaryotes form one domain.
Overall similarity in the appearance and way of life of the organisms being classified.
Comparison of the base sequences of ribosomal RNA across many different organisms.

questions.explanation: rRNA base sequences showed that prokaryotes form two groups, each as different from the other as from eukaryotes.

questions.stem: Illustrative data. A rock pool holds limpets 8, barnacles 6, periwinkles 4 and sea anemones 2. Using D = Σn(n − 1) ÷ N(N − 1), what is Simpson's index?

Two closely related bird species live in the same forest. The males of each species sing a different song, and females respond only to the song of their own species. What is the significance of this for the two species?

options.text: It is not a barrier to hybridisation, because only physical differences can stop two species breeding.
It lets the two species coexist by preventing them from competing with each other for food.
It shows that they are really one species, because they are so alike and live in the same forest.
It prevents hybridisation, so that alleles do not pass between the two gene pools.

questions.stem: What is the main advantage of a classification in which every group corresponds to evolutionary relationships?

options.text: The groups show which of the organisms are the most advanced.
Every species is given a unique name made up of two parts.
Organisms that look alike are placed together for identification.
Characteristics of members of a group can be predicted.

questions.explanation: When all members of a group evolved from one common ancestor, they share inherited features, so a member's features can be predicted.

questions.stem: Ecologists want to compare the species diversity of the plant communities in two meadows by calculating Simpson's Diversity Index for each. Which procedure is most appropriate?

options.text: List the different plant species found in each meadow, without counting the individuals of each.
Count the total number of plants in each meadow, without recording which species each belongs to.
Count the individuals of each species in several randomly placed quadrats of equal size in each meadow.
Count the individuals of each species in one quadrat placed in the middle of each meadow.

questions.stem: A population of lizards was split when rising sea level cut off an island from the mainland. Many generations later, island and mainland lizards can no longer produce fertile offspring together. Which statement about this speciation is correct?

options.text: Separation was enough by itself, and the two populations were different species as soon as they were cut off.
The populations only became different species once the lizards began to look different from one another.
Separation stopped gene flow, so selection on each side could change the two gene pools independently.
Lizards on the island developed the features they needed and then passed them on to their young.

questions.stem: The raven is Corvus corax, the rook is Corvus frugilegus and the magpie is Pica pica. What can be concluded from these names alone?

options.text: Raven and rook are two species of one genus, likely closer to each other than to the magpie.
The raven and the rook are one species, because the first word of their names, Corvus, is the same.
The word corax on its own is enough to name the raven in any country and in any language.
The first words say nothing about how the birds are related, so only the second words are needed.
